title: Inventor Mk II

featTraits.unstable: Unstable actions can yield unpredictable results. When you use an unstable action, first attempt a Crafting check against a standard DC for your level. On a critical success, your action works without a hitch. Otherwise, your action works normally, but your gizmos malfunction in spectacular (though harmless) fashion, such as with a belch of smoke or a shower of sparks, and you can’t use unstable actions until you use an Interact action to fix them, or two actions on a failure. On a critical failure, your action is also disrupted, and you can’t use unstable actions until you use three Interact actions to fix your gizmos.

description: An updated alternate take on the Inventor class for Pathfinder Second Edition that reworks their chassis and the unstable trait, with the aim of making innovations significantly more impactful.
